title: Dermot O'Leary
description: Faithful James Blunt joins Dermot to chat about his new Christmas single Another Day. Plus, Romesh may pop in to have a Traitors debrief.

title: Romesh Ranganathan
description: Actor, comedian and writer Daisy May Cooper joins Romesh live in the studio to talk about her debut novel What Took You So Long.

title: Mark Goodier
description: Spend Saturday lunchtime with Mark Goodier. Whether you're out and about or chilling at home, he is standing by to speak to you and hit shuffle on all your favourite music.

title: Rylan on Saturday
description: Sugababes icon Keisha Buchanan joins Rylan to spill the beans on her podcast The Girls Are Talking, revealing what goes on behind the mic, the candid conversations and the gossip.

title: Sounds of the 80s with Gary Davies
description: Featuring a U2 Mastermix and Boy George on Your Top 3. Gary also pays tribute to Duran Duran's Andy Taylor.

title: Sounds of the 90s with Fearne Cotton
description: Fearne's remembering the good, the bad, and the weird from this week in the 90s, all soundtracked by top 90s tunes.

title: Sounds of the 90s with Fearne Cotton
description: An hour of tunes that a teenage Fearne Cotton played on repeat... from the likes of Take That, The Prodigy and Shania Twain.

title: Dance Sounds of the 90s with Vernon Kay
description: An hour of back-to-back rave tracks from The Prodigy, N Joi, Liquid, Xpansions, Awesome 3, Congress, Shut Up and Dance, SL2, Manix and many more.

title: Alternative Sounds of the 90s with Dermot O'Leary
description: Dermot plays the biggest selling alternative albums of the 90s, including Oasis, REM and Moby.

title: CMA Music Festival 2026
description: 3/5. Shelly Fairchild with highlights of the CMA Music Festival 2026 in Nashville including Lainey Wilson, Tim McGraw, Jordan Davis, Carly Pearce, Riley Green, Zach Top and more.

title: Vernon Kay's Christmas Crooners
description: It's beginning to look a lot like Christmas! In the happiest Christmas show of all, Vernon Kay opens his Christmas Crooners Cracker full of your festive favourites this holiday season.

title: Radio 2 Unwinds Mix with Angela Griffin
description: De-stress and wind down from your day with a mix of soothing festive music, featuring Olivia Dean, Mariah Carey and Coldplay.

title: Tracks of My Years
description: Peter Gabriel joins Vernon Kay for an in-depth conversation about his life via ten of his favourite songs, as he releases his new album o/i.

title: Good Morning Sunday
description: The Reverend Kate Bottley spreads hope and joy, with uplifting stories about life, love and modern spirituality, alongside a great soundtrack for Sunday morning.

title: Love Songs with Michael Ball
description: Your true stories and favourite love songs with Michael... easy like Sunday morning.

title: Paddy McGuinness
description: Paddy's live from Salford and he needs your submissions for this year's little helpers. Who will make the nice list? Plus, The Weekest Link quiz the Serene 15, and Paddy's Timewarp.

title: Elaine Paige on Sunday
description: Elaine's got lots and lots of show tunes and movie songs, plus the latest stage and screen news, her Winter Warmer Double Bill, your requests, and your Pantomime Break a Legs.

title: Sounds of the 70s with Shaun Keaveny
description: The 'Bard of Salford', punk poet John Cooper Clarke is Shaun's 'My 70s' guest.

title: Pick of the Pops
description: Mark Goodier counts down the chart from this day in 1987.

title: Pick of the Pops
description: Mark Goodier counts down the chart from this day in 1994.

title: Tony Blackburn's Golden Hour
description: Tony Blackburn spins his personal pick of the hits from across the decades. To listen on most smart speakers just 'ask BBC Sounds to play Tony Blackburn's Golden Hour'.

title: The Paul Gambaccini Collection
description: Paul picks his favourite songs from every year - starting in 1958, working his way to 1982. So expect some Elton, Bobby Darin, Eagles, Ray Charles and Irene Cara.

title: Radio 2 Unwinds with Angela Griffin
description: Angela Griffin shares a selection of calming tunes for a cosy night in.

title: Radio 2 Unwinds Mix with Angela Griffin
description: Angela Griffin has a playlist perfect for late-night listening, featuring Brenda Russell, Janet Jackson, Sam Smith and many more.

title: Richie Anderson
description: Richie Anderson is live from Salford with your Monday Motivation to kick-start a brand new week, plus Secret Star and This Week in Songs.
